as_told.title: Washington Post reveals the Greenbrier bunker

plain: The story is that a secret underground bunker at Greenbrier, in West Virginia, was built to evacuate Congress in case of nuclear war, and that nobody knew about it until a newspaper exposed it in the 1990s. The TV writer Bryce Zabel tells it on the show from memory. He says "I think it was the Post," meaning the Washington Post, that broke the story, and he adds that "there's another one" in West Virginia. The same words show up in a later episode, credited this time to Brent Friedman, who works with Zabel. Neither teller names a document beyond the Post story. The point of telling it is that large hidden government facilities really have existed and stayed secret for decades. If that is so, other hidden sites could be out there too.
